y-m-48-10.material: Muna ƙirƙirar ƙaramin saiti X na babban saiti S={1, 2, 3, 4, 5}. Ga sharuddan: (가) 1 yana cikin X. (나) 3 da 5 ba sa cikin X tare (ɗaya ne kawai daga cikinsu yake ciki, ko kuma babu ko ɗaya). Za a ƙara sharadi (다) daga baya.

y-m-48-10.s.s1.hint.0: An riga an tantance abu 1. Ka raba ka rubuta ko za a iya saka 2 da 4 kowannensu, da kuma nau’i-nau’in da ake iya samu na 3 da 5.
y-m-48-10.s.s1.hint.1: Jera duk nau’i-nau’in da ake iya samu na 3 da 5, ka bar waɗanda suka cika (나) kawai, sannan ka ƙidaya su.
y-m-48-10.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ita ce ƙimar ƙidayar lokutan saka abu 1 da shigar ko barin kowane abu daga 2, 3, 4, 5 (2⁴). Ba ka yi amfani da sharadi (나) ba tukuna.
y-m-48-10.s.s1.r.c: Dole ne a cire shari’o’in da suka karya (나), amma ka ƙara su. Ka sake tunani kan shari’o’in da ya kamata a cire daga jimilla.
y-m-48-10.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi la’akari da ɗaya kawai daga 3 da 5? Jera dukkan yanayin da 3 da 5 za su iya kasancewa.
y-m-48-10.s.s1.explain: Abubuwa 2 da 4 kowannensu yana iya ciki ko waje, hakan ya ba da hanyoyi 2×2=4; 3 da 5 kuma suna da hanyoyi 3 (babu ko ɗaya, 3 kaɗai, 5 kaɗai), saboda haka 4×3=12. Haka nan, cire shari’o’i 4 da duka 3 da 5 suke ciki daga 16 ɗin da suka haɗa da 1 yana ba da 12.
y-m-48-10.s.s2.prompt: Ƙara sharadi (다): X yana da abubuwa 3 ko fiye. Samar da ƙananan saiti X 4 daban-daban da suka cika (가), (나), da (다). Ga kowane x1 zuwa x5, saka 1 idan lambar tana cikin X, 0 kuma idan ba ta ciki.

y-m-48-04.topic: Misalan karyatawa da ƙarin sharadin da ke sa magana ta tabbata

y-m-48-04.material: Ga lambobin gaske a da b, Hyunwoo ya ce, “Idan a²>b², to a>b” gaskiya ce. Ta yi aiki idan a=3, b=2, haka nan idan a=5, b=1.” (Ana karanta a² da “a murabba’i”.)

y-m-48-02.title: Wane irin sharadi ne “x=2” ga “x²=4”?
y-m-48-02.topic: Sharuddan wajibi da isasshe, da tasirin babban saiti
y-m-48-02.goal: Yi bayani da misalan karyatawa da saitukan gaskiya cewa tantance sharadi wajibi ko isasshe kan iya sauyawa bisa babban saiti, sannan ka ƙirƙiri wani sharadi mai ma’ana iri ɗaya.
y-m-48-02.material: Sharadi p: x²=4, sharadi q: x=2. Alaƙar sharuddan biyu na iya sauyawa bisa babban saiti (yankin lambobin da x zai iya kasancewa), saboda haka ka duba babban saiti a kowane lokaci. (Ana karanta x²=4 da “x murabba’i ya yi daidai da 4”, |x|=2 kuma da “cikakkiyar ƙimar x ita ce 2”.)

y-m-48-02.s.s1.prompt: Bi yadda hukuncin ke sauyawa a duk lokacin da babban saiti da sharuddan suka canza.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, rubuta duk x da suka cika p da duk x da suka cika q a cikin babban saiti.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta rukunonin biyu: ɗaya yana ƙunshe gaba ɗaya a cikin ɗayan ne, ko dai sun yi daidai?
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Babban saitin duk lambobin gaske ne. Sharadi p: x²=4, sharadi q: x=2.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wane irin sharadi ne q ga p? (Auna dabam ko “idan q, to p” gaskiya ce da ko “idan p, to q”.)
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan x=2, to x²=4; saboda haka “idan q, to p” gaskiya ce. Amma x=−2 yana cika p amma bai cika q ba; saboda haka “idan p, to q” ƙarya ce. Don haka q sharadi ne isasshe ga p, amma ba wajibi ba ne.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Sharadi wajibi ne amma ba cikakken isasshe ba
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Da farko duba ko “idan q, to p” yana aiki. Me zai faru idan aka saka x=2 a p?
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne da aka yanke ta lura cewa “idan q, to p” gaskiya ce, “idan p, to q” kuma ƙarya ce.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Duba ko 2 ne kaɗai x da ke cika p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba sharadi wajibi ba ne, kuma ba isasshe ba ne
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ka duba ko “idan q, to p” yana aiki? Saka x=2 a p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Yanzu rage babban saiti zuwa “duk lambobin gaske masu kyau”. p: x²=4 da q: x=2 suna nan yadda suke.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: A cikin wannan babban saiti, wane irin sharadi ne q ga p?
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.after: A cikin lambobin gaske masu kyau, 2 ne kaɗai x mai x²=4; saboda haka saitin gaskiyar p da na q sun yi daidai. Don haka a wannan babban saitin sharadi ne wajibi kuma isasshe. Ko da sharuddan iri ɗaya ne, hukunci na iya sauyawa idan babban saiti ya sauya.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka bar hukuncinka na farko yadda yake. Rubuta yadda rukunin x masu cika p ke sauyawa idan an rage babban saiti.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Fara da duba ko “idan q, to p” yana aiki. A wannan babban saitin ma, x=2 yana cika p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka yanke hukuncin ne ta ganin cewa rukunin x masu cika p da rukunin x masu cika q iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Babban saiti ya sauya, saboda haka ba za a iya tantancewa ba.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Da zarar an kayyade babban saiti, za ka iya tantancewa. Rubuta duk x da suka cika p da q a cikinsa.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Mayar da babban saiti zuwa duk lambobin gaske. A wannan karon, bar p yadda yake, amma sauya q zuwa wani sharadi domin ya zama wajibi kuma isasshe ga p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zaɓi sharadin da zai iya maye gurbin q. (Akwai fiye da amsa ɗaya da za ta yiwu.)
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Saitin gaskiyar p shi ne {−2, 2}. Duka |x|=2 da “x=2 ko x=−2” saitin nan ne daidai, saboda haka sharuddan wajibi ne kuma isasshe, furucinsu kuma daban ne amma ma’anarsu iri ɗaya ce. x>0 yana cire −2, x²≥4 kuma yana ƙunshe da ƙarin ƙimomi kamar 3.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Yana ƙunshe da x=2 kawai, ya bar x=−2 a waje. Kwatanta shi da saitin gaskiyar p, {−2, 2}.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Yana ƙunshe da x=2 da x=−2 duka, saboda haka ya yi daidai da saitin gaskiyar p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: x² ya kai 4 ko ya fi (x²≥4)
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Yana ƙunshe da duk x masu cika p, amma yana kuma ƙunshe da ƙimomi kamar x=3 da ba ya cika p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan hukunci ne da ya kwafi saitin gaskiyar p, {−2, 2}, yadda yake.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.reflect: Dalilin da ya sa hukunci ya sauya a mataki na 2 ba sauyin sharudda ba ne, sauyin babban saiti ne. Ka taƙaita da kalmominka cewa sharadi iri ɗaya na iya samun saitin gaskiya daban bisa babban saiti. Ta yaya za a bayyana sauyin q a mataki na 3 ta saitukan gaskiya?
y-m-48-02.s.s2.prompt: Ka yi bayani ta amfani da takamaiman ƙimar x guda ɗaya dalilin da ya sa za a ce “x=2 ba sharadi wajibi ba ne ga x²=4” idan babban saiti duk lambobin gaske ne.

y-m-48-01.title: Nemo layin kuskure a jerin binciken Minseo.
y-m-48-01.topic: Mataimakin furuci, kishiyar furuci da musun kishiya, da yanke hukunci kan gaskiya ko ƙarya.
y-m-48-01.goal: Bambanta sharadi da ƙarshe daidai, rarrabe kishiya, musun sharadi da musun kishiya, sannan bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba za a yarda da ƙarshe daga furucin da aka gina ba daidai ba.
y-m-48-01.material: Saitin duniya shi ne dukkan lambobin ainihi. Minseo ta bincika furuci p: “Idan x>2, to x²>4” kamar yadda aka nuna a ƙasa. (Ana karanta x² “x murabba’i”. “≤” na nufin “ya gaza ko ya yi daidai da”.)
y-m-48-01.thinking.0: Nemo inda kuskure ya fara a aikin.
y-m-48-01.thinking.1: Yanke hukunci kan furuci ƙarya ta amfani da misalin ƙaryatawa.
y-m-48-01.thinking.2: Nemo furucin da gaskiya/ƙaryarsa ta yi daidai da ta asali.
y-m-48-01.prereq.0: Tsammanin jerin karatu: “H2” a wannan aiki matakin wahala da tallafi ne kawai a aikin samarwa; ba yana nufin Ma’aikatar Ilimi ta ware wannan abun ga wani aji ba. A ɗauka mai koyo ya riga ya yi lissafin makarantar sakandare (furucin algebra, rashin daidaiton layi) da kalmomin saiti na asali a Common Math na sakandare (ƙaramin saiti, haɗi, tsinkaya, ciko, adadin abubuwa).
y-m-48-01.prereq.1: Bambanta sharadi da ƙarshe a furuci p→q.
y-m-48-01.prereq.2: Duba mafitar rashin daidaito x²>4 a kan layin lambobi ko ta saka ƙimomi.
y-m-48-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda mai kuskure a tsarin binciken Minseo.
y-m-48-01.s.s1.hint.0: Raba p da furucan da aka samu daga kishiyarsa, musun sharadinsa da musun kishiyarsa zuwa kwalaye biyu: “sharadi → ƙarshe”, sannan ka rubuta su.
y-m-48-01.s.s1.hint.1: Yi alama ka kwatanta yadda kowane layi ya canza sharadi da ƙarshe na p (ya bar yadda yake / ya musanya wurare / ya yi musunsu).
y-m-48-01.s.s1.line.0: p: Idan x>2, to x²>4. Idan x>2, to x tabbatacce ne kuma x·x>2·2, saboda haka p gaskiya ne.
y-m-48-01.s.s1.line.1: Kishiyar p: Idan x²>4, to x>2.
y-m-48-01.s.s1.line.2: Musun kishiyar p: Idan x≤2, to x²≤4.
y-m-48-01.s.s1.line.3: Idan x=−3, to x≤2 amma x²=9>4, saboda haka wannan furuci ƙarya ne.
y-m-48-01.s.s1.line.4: Furuci na asali da musun kishiyarsa suna da ƙima ɗaya ta gaskiya. Saboda haka p ƙarya ne.
y-m-48-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ne inda matsala ta fara. “Idan x≤2, to x²≤4” furuci ne (musun sharadi) da aka samu ta musanta sharadi da ƙarshe kawai; musun kishiya kuwa yana sanya musun ƙarshe ya zama sharadi, musun sharadi kuma ya zama ƙarshe: “Idan x²≤4, to x≤2”. Saboda haka ƙarshe a layi na 5 ma kuskure ne. Layi na 1 ya riga ya nuna cewa p gaskiya ne; musun kishiya madaidaiciya “Idan x²≤4, to x≤2” ma gaskiya ne. Lissafin layi na 4 (x=−3) daidai ne ga furucin da aka gina ba daidai ba.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.prompt: Ko da p gaskiya ne, kishiyarsa na iya zama ƙarya. Shigar da lambobin ainihi x guda biyu dabam-dabam da ke nuna kishiyar “Idan x²>4, to x>2” ƙarya ce.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.hint.0: Raba x-ɗin da ke cika sharadin kishiya x²>4 zuwa masu kyau da marasa kyau, ka rubuta wasu daga kowanne.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowace ƙima da ka rubuta, duba ko ƙarshe x>2 gaskiya ne, ka zaɓi waɗanda ba su cika ba.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.ok.c1: x² ya fi 4, saboda haka sharadin kishiya ya cika.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.fail.c1: x² bai fi 4 ba. Sharadin kishiya bai cika ba, saboda haka wannan ƙimar ba za ta zama misalin ƙaryatawa ba.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.ok.c2: x ya kai 2 ko ya gaza, saboda haka ƙarshe “x>2” bai cika ba.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.fail.c2: x ya fi 2. Ƙarshe “x>2” ya cika, saboda haka wannan ba misalin ƙaryatawa ba ne.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.explain: x²>4 gaskiya ne idan x>2 ko x<−2. Ƙimomi x<−2 (misali −3, −2.5, −5) suna cika sharadi amma suna karya ƙarshe, saboda haka kishiyar ƙarya ce.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.prompt: Sabon furuci q: “Idan x ninkuwar 6 ne, to x ninkuwar 3 ne” (x cikakkiyar lamba ce) gaskiya ne. Cikin kishiya, musun sharadi da musun kishiyar q, wanne za a iya cewa gaskiya ne kai tsaye daga gaskiyar q kaɗai?
y-m-48-01.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta q, kishiyarsa, musun sharadinsa da musun kishiyarsa a akwatunan “sharadi → ƙarshe”, ka nuna wanda ya canza akwatunan q da yadda.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ga waɗanda kake zargin gaskiya ne, saka ƙimomi kamar 3, 6, 9 ka gwada cewa babu misalin ƙaryatawa.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.a: Kishiyar q: Idan x ba shi da rabo da 6, to ba shi da rabo da 3.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.r.a: x=3 misalin karyatawa ne. 3 ba shi da rabo da 6, amma yana da rabo da 3. Wannan bai danganta da gaskiyar maganar asali ba.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.b: Kishiyar magana ta q: Idan x ba shi da rabo da 3, to ba shi da rabo da 6.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.c: Juzu’in magana ta q: Idan x yana da rabo da 3, to yana da rabo da 6.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.r.c: x=3 misalin karyatawa ne. 3 yana da rabo da 3 amma ba shi da rabo da 6. Ko da maganar asali gaskiya ce, dole a binciki gaskiyar juzu’inta dabam.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.d: Daga q kaɗai ba za a iya cewa juzu’i, kishiya, ko kishiyar juzu’i gaskiya ce ba.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.r.d: Kishiyar magana tana da ƙimar gaskiya iri ɗaya da ta maganar asali koyaushe. Da farko a tantance wace ce kishiyar magana.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.explain: Kishiyar magana tana da ƙimar gaskiya iri ɗaya da ta maganar asali koyaushe; saboda haka idan q gaskiya ce, kishiyar “Idan x ba shi da rabo da 3, to ba shi da rabo da 6” ma gaskiya ce. Dole a binciki juzu’i da kishiyar juzu’i dabam da q; a wannan yanayin x=3 misalin karyatawa ne, saboda haka duka ƙarya ne.

y-m-48-03.title: Nemo ƙimar a da za ta sa sharadi ya zama isasshe
y-m-48-03.topic: Ƙunshewar saitukan gaskiya da yankin harafin a
y-m-48-03.goal: Mayar da sharadi isasshe zuwa ƙunshewar saitukan gaskiya, samar da ƙimomin a da dama, sannan ka bayyana yadda haɗa ko barin iyakokin ke shafar yankin.
y-m-48-03.material: Akwai sharudda biyu game da lambar gaske x. p: −1≤x≤2, q: |x−a|≤3 (a lamba ce ta gaske). Muna son zaɓar a ta yadda “idan p, to q” gaskiya ce. (Ana karanta |x−a| da “cikakkiyar ƙimar x cire a”. |x−a|≤3 na nufin x ba ta fi 3 nisa daga a ba.)
y-m-48-03.thinking.0: Mayar da sharadi isasshe zuwa ƙunshewar saitukan gaskiya
y-m-48-03.thinking.1: Samar da mafita da dama da suka cika ƙuntatawa
y-m-48-03.thinking.2: Kwatanta yankuna bisa ko an haɗa iyakoki

y-m-48-03.prereq.2: Duba ƙunshewar tazara a kan layin lambobi
y-m-48-03.s.s1.prompt: Idan “idan p, to q” gaskiya ce, me hakan ke nufi ga P da Q, rukunin x (saitukan gaskiya) masu cika p da q?
y-m-48-03.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta da kalmomi irin x da ake bukata domin “idan p, to q” ta zama ƙarya.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada jimlar da ƙananan rukuni kamar P={1, 2}, Q={1, 2, 3} domin duba ko ta dace.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.o.a: Kowane x a Q yana cikin P ma.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.r.a: An juya alkiblar. “Idan p, to q” na nufin idan p ta cika, q ma ta cika.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.o.b: Akwai aƙalla x guda da ke cikin P da Q duka.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.r.b: Samun mahaɗi a wuri guda aƙalla ya bambanta da cewa kowane x na P yana cikin Q. Idan akwai x a P da ba ya cikin Q, misalin karyatawa ne.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.o.c: Kowane x a P yana cikin Q ma.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.o.d: P da Q suna da yawan x iri ɗaya.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.r.d: Yawan rukuni iri ɗaya ba ya sa rukunan su zama daidai, kuma ba ya nuna cewa ɗaya yana ƙunshe da ɗayan.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.explain: Gaskiyar “idan p, to q” tana nufin kowane x da ya cika p yana cika q ma; saboda haka P⊂Q.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da lambobin gaske 4 daban-daban na a da ke sa p: −1≤x≤2 ya zama sharadi isasshe ga q: |x−a|≤3. Ba dole su zama lambobi cikakku ba.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sake rubuta |x−a|≤3 a matsayin yankin (tazara) na x, sannan ka zana shi a layin lambobi tare da P.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi ƙimar a, sannan ka duba ko iyakokin P, −1 da 2, duka suna cikin yankin q.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Ƙarshen hagu a−3 na q yana daidai da −1 ko ƙasa da shi, saboda haka ya kai zuwa ƙarshen hagu na P.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ƙarshen hagu a−3 na q ya fi −1 girma, saboda haka wani ɓangaren hagu na P yana waje da q.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Ƙarshen dama a+3 na q yana daidai da 2 ko ya fi shi girma, saboda haka ya kai zuwa ƙarshen dama na P.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ƙarshen dama a+3 na q bai kai 2 ba, saboda haka wani ɓangaren dama na P yana waje da q.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.explain: q ita ce a−3≤x≤a+3. Domin P={x | −1≤x≤2} ta kasance gaba ɗaya a cikin Q, muna bukatar a−3≤−1 da 2≤a+3; saboda haka −1≤a≤2. Duk ƙima a cikin wannan zangon amsa ce daidai.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Idan a=3, p ba sharadi isasshe ba ne ga q. Ka yi bayani ta hanyar bayar da takamaiman ƙimar x guda ɗaya a P.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Saka a=3 a cikin furucin q, sannan ka rubuta q a matsayin tazara ta x.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nemo ka rubuta x guda a P da ba ya cikin tazarar q.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali, idan a=3, yankin q shi ne ..., kuma x=... ne ...
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Shin x ɗin da ka zaɓa yana cikin P da gaske (daga −1 zuwa 2)?
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka nemo yankin q idan a=3 sannan ka kwatanta shi da wannan x?
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan a=3, q ita ce 0≤x≤6. x=−1 a P ba ya cikin q; saboda haka akwai x da ke cika p amma ba q ba, kuma p ba sharadi isasshe ba ne.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan a=3, q daga 0 zuwa 6 ce, amma ƙimomi kamar −1, ƙarshen hagu na p, ko −0.5 suna wajen wannan yanki. Saboda haka “idan p, to q” ba ta aiki.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.prompt: Bar p a −1≤x≤2, amma sauya q zuwa |x−a|<3 (babu alamar daidaito). Wane yanki na a ne zai sa p ya zama sharadi isasshe ga q?
y-m-48-03.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta q a matsayin tazara idan a=−1 da a=2, sannan ka duba ko iyakokin P suna cikinta.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta ƙimomin iyaka a=−1 da a=2 da ƙimar ciki a=0.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.r.a: Ka ɗauke shi kamar shari’ar da ta haɗa iyakoki. Idan a=2, q ita ce −1<x<5; duba ko x=−1 a P yana cikinta.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.r.b: Duba shari’ar a=2. q: −1<x<5, P kuma tana da x=−1.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.r.c: Duba shari’ar a=−1. q: −4<x<2, P kuma tana da x=2.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.explain: Iyakoki biyu −1 da 2 suna cikin P, amma wannan Q ba ta haɗa iyakokinta ba. Saboda haka muna bukatar a−3<−1 da 2<a+3, don haka −1<a<2.

y-m-48-05.title: Dalibai nawa ba su shiga ko wane kulob ba?
y-m-48-05.topic: Yawan abubuwan saiti da ko bayanin ya wadatar
y-m-48-05.goal: Ka gane cewa bayanai kaɗai ba su kayyade ƙima guda ba, ka bayyana ƙarin abin da ake buƙatar sani da kewayon ƙimomin da za su yiwu.
y-m-48-05.material: Cikin ɗaliban aji na farko 40 a wata makaranta, 18 sun shiga ƙungiyar karatu A, 15 kuma sun shiga ƙungiyar coding B. Ɗalibi na iya shiga ƙungiyoyin biyun. Majalisar ɗalibai tana son sanin “ɗalibai nawa ba su shiga ko ɗaya ba”. Abin da aka sani yanzu shi ne jimillar 40, n(A)=18 da n(B)=15. (Ana karanta n(A) “adadin abubuwan A”.) y-m-48-05.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci ko bayanin ya isa.
y-m-48-05.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri yanayi masu yiwuwa idan bayani ya ɓace.
y-m-48-05.thinking.2: Yi amfani da kewayon ƙimomi don ware furucin da ba zai yiwu ba.
y-m-48-05.prereq.1: Adadin abubuwan saiti mai iyaka (yadda ake ƙirga abubuwan haɗin saiti).
y-m-48-05.s.s1.prompt: Da bayanin da aka sani yanzu kaɗai (ɗalibai 40 gaba ɗaya, 18 a ƙungiyar karatu, 15 a ƙungiyar coding), za a iya kayyade ainihin adadin waɗanda ba su shiga ko ɗaya ba?
y-m-48-05.s.s1.hint.0: Raba ɗaliban da suka shiga A kaɗai, B kaɗai, da biyun, sannan rubuta waɗanda aka haɗa cikin 18 da cikin 15.
y-m-48-05.s.s1.hint.1: A ɗauka haɗuwar ɗalibai 0 ce da 5 ne, lissafa waɗanda ba su shiga a kowane yanayi, sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-48-05.s.s1.o.a: Ɗalibai 7 ne. Domin 18+15=33 ne suka shiga.
y-m-48-05.s.s1.r.a: Ɗalibin da ya shiga ƙungiyoyin biyun yana cikin adadin 18 da 15 duka. Duba ko an ƙirga waɗannan ɗalibai sau biyu.
y-m-48-05.s.s1.o.b: Ba za a iya kayyade ba. Muna buƙatar sanin ajin dukkan ɗalibai 40.
y-m-48-05.s.s1.r.b: Ajin bayani ne da ba shi da alaƙa da shiga ƙungiya. Nemo abin da ya ɓace a dangantakar lambobin.
y-m-48-05.s.s1.o.c: Ba za a iya kayyade ba. Ya danganta da adadin ɗaliban da suka shiga biyun.
y-m-48-05.s.s1.o.d: Ɗalibai 20 ne. Tunda ƙungiyoyi biyu ne, sai a raba 40 gida biyu.
y-m-48-05.s.s1.r.d: Raba ɗalibai da adadin ƙungiyoyi ba ya ba da adadin waɗanda ba su shiga ba. Da farko lissafa adadin waɗanda suka shiga.
y-m-48-05.s.s1.explain: Adadin waɗanda suka shiga shi ne n(A)+n(B)−n(A∩B)=33−n(A∩B). Idan ba mu san adadin waɗanda suka haɗu n(A∩B) ba, ba za a iya kayyade adadin waɗanda ba su shiga ba, wato 40−(33−n(A∩B)).
y-m-48-05.s.s2.prompt: Mu ƙirƙiri yanayi masu yiwuwa. Shigar da biyun (k, n) guda 3 dabam-dabam, inda k adadin waɗanda suka shiga biyun ne, n kuma waɗanda ba su shiga ba, ba tare da saɓa wa bayanin ba.

y-m-48-05.s.s4.hint.1: Duba a tebur ko n yana ƙaruwa ko raguwa yayin da k ke ƙaruwa.

y-m-48-05.s.s4.o.b: Ba za mu iya sani ba. Ba mu san adadin waɗanda suka shiga biyun ba, saboda haka kowace ƙima tana yiwuwa.

y-m-48-05.s.s4.r.c: Idan adadin haɗuwar ɗalibai ya ƙaru, ainihin adadin waɗanda suka shiga yana raguwa. Saboda haka adadin waɗanda ba su shiga yana ƙaruwa.
y-m-48-05.s.s4.o.d: Ba zai yiwu ba. 5 cikin 40 kamar kaɗan ne ƙwarai.
y-m-48-05.s.s4.r.d: Dole ne ka kwatanta da kewayon da aka lissafa, ba da jin zato ba. Duba mafi ƙarancin ƙimar n.
y-m-48-05.s.s4.explain: n=7+k kuma k≥0, saboda haka n aƙalla 7 ne. Ko ba tare da sanin haɗuwar ba, 5 yana wajen kewayon ƙimomin da za su yiwu (7 zuwa 22), saboda haka furucin ba zai iya zama daidai ba. Ko da bayani ya ɓace, za mu iya yanke hukunci kan ƙimomin da ba za su yiwu ba.

y-m-48-07.title: Idan aka binciki misalai da yawa, shin hakan ya zama hujja?
y-m-48-07.topic: Furuci masu “duk”, misalan ƙaryatawa, da iyakar binciken misalai.
y-m-48-07.goal: Ka fahimci daga bayanai da ake bayarwa mataki-mataki cewa ba za a iya tabbatar da furucin “ga duk n” ta binciken wasu ƙimomi ba, kuma misalin ƙaryatawa guda yana tabbatar da ƙaryarsa; bayyana bambancinsa da furucin samuwa.
y-m-48-07.material: A kira furuci mai zuwa q. q: “Ga kowace lambar ƙidaya n, n²+n+41 lambar firimiya ce.” (Ana karanta n² “n murabba’i”. Lambar firimiya ita ce lambar ƙidaya da ta fi 1, kuma masu rabonta su ne 1 da ita kaɗai.) Za a bayyana bayanan ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
y-m-48-07.thinking.1: Daidaita ƙarfin tabbaci da sabon bayani.
y-m-48-07.thinking.2: Kwatanta aikin misalai a furucin “ga kowane” da “akwai”.
y-m-48-07.prereq.1: Ma’anar lambar firimiya da gwajin kasancewarta firimiya.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai mataki-mataki. A kowane lokaci, zaɓi tunaninka game da q.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bambanta ko bayanin kowane mataki ya ƙunshi dukkan lambobin ƙidaya n ko wasu kaɗan ne kawai.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.hint.1: Yi lissafin sabon bayanin da kanka, ka duba ko ya yi daidai da ƙimomin da aka bayar.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Idan aka saka n=1, 2, 3, 4, 5, n²+n+41 yana ba da 43, 47, 53, 61, 71, kuma dukkan su lambobin firimiya ne.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me kake tunani game da q yanzu?
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.after: Sakamako biyar alama ce da ke nuna q na iya zama gaskiya, amma ba su ƙunshi “kowace lambar ƙidaya n” ba, saboda haka ba hujja ba ce.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Duk biyar firimiya ne, saboda haka an tabbatar da q.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Biyar wasu ne kawai cikin dukkan lambobin ƙidaya. Har yanzu ba mu san ko q ya cika ga n da ba mu saka ba.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Lambobin firimiya sun biyo juna bisa sa’a, saboda haka mai yiwuwa q ƙarya ce.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Fitowar lambobin firimiya a jere alama ce da ke goyon bayan q. Amma samun alama ba dalili ba ne na ayyana q ƙarya.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Q na iya zama gaskiya, amma ba a tabbatar da ita ba.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Biyar ba ta ba da wani bayani ko kaɗan.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Alama ce da ke nuna yiwuwar q gaskiya ce. Amma muhimmin abu shi ne ba hujja ba ce.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Kwamfuta ta lissafa komai daga n=1 zuwa 39, kuma duk lambobin firimiya ne.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Me za ka yi yanzu? Zaɓi ayyukan da suka dace. (Zaɓi fiye da ɗaya na iya yiwuwa.)
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Gwada ƙima ta gaba kai tsaye (nema misalin ƙaryatawa) da nemo dalilin da ya sa yake cika ga kowane n (tabbatarwa), duka hanyoyi ne masu dacewa. Binciken ƙimomi 39 yana ƙara tabbaci amma ba ya tabbatar da q.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Dukkan 39 sun yi daidai, saboda haka a ɗauki q a matsayin tabbatacciya a tsaya.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ko 39 wasu ne kawai cikin dukkan lambobin ƙidaya. Adadin ƙimomin da aka bincika ba ma’aunin tabbatarwa ba ne.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Lissafa ƙimomin gaba kai tsaye, kamar n=40 da 41.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Nemo dalilin kasancewarsa firimiya a cikin furucin, ka yi ƙoƙarin bayyana shi.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ka ɗauka na arba’in ma zai yi daidai, don haka babu buƙatar sake bincike. [lambobi: 40]
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Yiwuwa ba yana nufin gaskiya ba. Misalin ƙaryatawa na iya bayyana a ƙimar da ba ka bincika ba tukuna.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me za ka ce game da q yanzu?
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan n=40, n²+n+41=41×41 ba lambar firimiya ba ce, saboda haka q ƙarya ce. Misalin ƙaryatawa guda yana sa furucin “ga kowane n” ya zama ƙarya. n=41 ma ba firimiya ba ne, saboda haka ba za a gyara shi da cire keɓantacciyar ƙima guda ba.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yawancin n yana ba da lambar firimiya, saboda haka a ɗauki q kusan gaskiya a yi amfani da ita yadda take.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Furucin “ga kowane n” ƙarya ne idan ko yanayi guda ya gaza. “Mafi yawansu” ba abin da q ke faɗa ba ne.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Gyara shi ta cire n=40 kaɗai, “idan n ba 40 ba ne, to lambar firimiya ce”, kuma ya zama gaskiya.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: n=41 ma yana ba da 41²+41+41=41×43, wanda ba firimiya ba ne. Dole ne a sake gwada furucin da aka gyara ta hanyar cire keɓantacciyar ƙima guda.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wataƙila 1681 kuskuren lissafi ne, saboda haka a jinkirta hukunci.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Za ka iya tabbatar da 41×41 ta ninkawa kai tsaye. Lissafin da za a iya dubawa, a duba shi kafin hukunci.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.o.d: q ƙarya ce. n=40 misalin ƙaryatawa ne.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.reflect: Ta yaya tabbacin da kake da shi game da q ya canza a matakai na 1, 2 da 3? Wane bayani ya ƙara tabbaci kawai, kuma wane bayani ne ya kawo ƙarshen hukuncin? Ka bayyana alaƙar wannan bambanci da bambancin “akwai misalai da yawa” da “akwai misali guda”.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.prompt: A ce q′ shi ne “akwai lambar ƙidaya n da n²+n+41 lamba ce mai haɗaɗɗiya (lamba mafi girma da 1 wadda ba firimiya ba)”. Me za mu iya cewa game da q′ daga bayanin mataki na 3 kaɗai?
y-m-48-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ka bayyana da kalmomi irin n da ake buƙata domin q′ ta zama gaskiya, sannan ka duba ko 40 ya cika sharadin.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta gefe da gefe aikin n=40 a q da q′, sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.o.a: n=40 guda ɗaya ya isa ya tabbatar da cewa q′ gaskiya ce.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.o.b: Dole ne mu bincika ƙarin n domin sanin ko gaskiya ne ko ƙarya.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.r.b: q′ magana ce ta “akwai”, saboda haka tana zama gaskiya da zarar an sami misali guda da ya cika sharadin. Duba ko 40 irin wannan misali ne.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.o.c: Ƙarya ce, domin mafi yawan n suna ba da lambobin farko.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.r.c: Maganar “akwai” tana tambayar ko akwai ko da misali guda, ba ko mafi yawansu ba.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.o.d: Ba za a iya cewa gaskiya ce ba. Misalin karyatawa ya shafi q ne, ba q′ ba.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.r.d: Ƙimar n=40 ɗin nan da ta zama misalin karyatawa a q tana zama misalin da ya cika sharadin a q′. Kwatanta yadda maganganun biyu suke amfani da ƙima ɗaya ta hanyoyi daban.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.explain: q, maganar “ga kowane n”, tana zama ƙarya da misalin karyatawa guda ɗaya; q′, maganar “akwai wani n”, kuma tana zama gaskiya da misali guda da ya cika sharadin. A gefe guda, binciken misalai ko nawa ne bai isa a ce q gaskiya ba.
